fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow fire apparatus and emergency vehicles to reach the residence and detached structure.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive to maintain a clear path wide enough for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can move around it without obstruction.
• Install a reflective marker or sign at the detached structure identifying it as a separate building on the property.
• Post the solar panel system location and shut-off point in a visible location near the main electrical panel or front entry for arriving responders.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings on foot.
• If the perimeter fencing includes a gate at the rear, keep it unlocked or provide a Knox-type lock so responders can reach the rear of the property without returning to the front.
• Mark any pedestrian gate in the perimeter fencing with a reflective indicator so responders can locate it quickly under low-light or smoke conditions.
• Trim vegetation along the interior perimeter of the fence line so responders can move along the fence without obstruction.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs and low branches that are growing directly against or touching the house on all sides.
• Clear a wider open gap between the shrubs scattered around the house and the exterior walls.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material from shrubs growing close to the structure.
• Thin the shrubs nearest the house so they are separated from each other and not forming a continuous line toward the structure.
• Keep the driveway clear of overhanging branches and shrubs along its full length so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Maintain the long driveway surface free of encroaching vegetation that could narrow vehicle access over time.
• Keep the single access route clear at both the entry point and along the full length so it can be used quickly under emergency conditions.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to locate from the main road.
